public_profile.summary: Somerset Capital Partners is a family-owned investment firm investing in public and private companies. Its stated fields include real estate, the energy transition, internet, software and technology-enabled industries. It launched its public-equity business in 2008 and has invested in European private companies from Series A to pre-IPO since 2015.

track_record.description: EUCLYD Series A (15 September 2026): EUCLYD announced a company-wide round of more than €200 million, co-led by Somerset and three other investors. Somerset’s individual investment amount was not disclosed.
Somerset’s company announcement describes an investment supporting the growth of hotel operator Black Label Hospitality; the amount and investment return were not disclosed.

sources.quote: Somerset Capital Partners is a family-owned investment firm, focused on private and public companies, in the real estate, energy transition, internet, software and technology-enabled industries. Launched in 2008, our public equity business applies a fundamentally oriented, long-term investment approach. Since 2015, our private equity business has invested in companies across Europe, including investments ranging from Series A to pre-IPO. Media enquiries: media.enquiries@somerset.eu. SCP Management B.V., De Lind 39, 5061 HT Oisterwijk, The Netherlands. T. +31 (0)13 - 523 1700 E. capitalpartners@somerset.eu.

sources.quote: EUCLYD has signed a Series A financing round of more than €200 million. The round is co-led by Samsung, Somerset Capital Partners, Scaleup Europe Fund, which is managed by EQT, and Innovation Industries.
